Per our conversation, I wanted to officially kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, deliverables, and a close timeline for the evaluation. The focus from the GRC side is the SOC 2 evidence collection and confirming data handling boundaries for the pilot.

High-level proposal (please confirm):
- MAP owner (Redwood): me (Sofia) — overall coordination and weekly syncs
- SOC 2 / evidence owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — point for artifact collection and technical evidence
- Legal / procurement lead (Redwood): Laura Bennett — contract/PO and DPA items
- Your GRC contacts: please confirm the best person for evidence intake and a legal contact for indemnities/PO windows

Proposed close timeline:
- Evidence intake (initial set): by 2026-03-01
- We run internal eval + follow-ups: Mar 2–Mar 10
- Contract and sign: target week of 2026-03-15 (flexible with mutual alignment)

I attached a one-tab MAP draft to get us started (Redwood-SurgiTech-MAP-draft.xlsx). Can you confirm the GRC inbox + preferred format for evidence (Drive link, email, vendor portal)? Also, are there any items you need from our side up front (architecture diagram, data flow, subprocessors)?

Would you be available for a 30-min kickoff call on Thursday 2026-02-12 at 10:00 AM PT? If that time doesn't work, please suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

- Primary GRC intake: Anjali Mehra (GRC Manager) — anjali.mehra@surgitech.com

Thanks — looping in a short set of assignments from our side so roles are explicit:

- SOC 2 / evidence collection: Karthik Iyer (me) — I will own the artifact index and the technical handoff. Please send any artifact links to me and I will tag with the control mapping.
- Legal / contract owner: Laura Bennett — she will coordinate PO/timing and review the DPA redlines.
- MAP coordinator: Sofia (manages weekly syncs and progress tracking)

Refined timeline
- Evidence index and first artifact upload: target 2026-03-01
- Redwood review + clarification questions: Mar 2–8
- Final evidence submission and sign-off readiness: Mar 10–15
- Contract signature target: week of Mar 15 (Laura will propose the PO timeline)

I uploaded a lightweight MAP sheet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_map_sheet (view/comment) — please add / comment on owners and dates. I also attached the MAP draft for you to keep locally.

We will bring the following items to the kickoff call:
- Short architecture diagram (1 slide) and data flow summary
- Initial artifact index template (spreadsheet)
- List of our current subprocessors and retention policy summary

Mark — on your questions:
1) Pilot data classification: typical pilot includes email addresses, user display names, and small product telemetry. No payment data or sensitive health data. We will include a hard list in the architecture doc for the call.
2) SOC 2 scope: we are happy to share a short scope statement and the SOC 2 opinion letter in the call — I will bring that slide to the kickoff.

Proposed meeting: Thu Feb 12, 2026 10:00 AM PT — will send calendar invite once confirmed.
